other_conditions: Girl child must be born on or after 01/04/2015
benefits_summary: The scheme provides a government‑funded recurring deposit of ₹1000 per month for 14 years, followed by a 7‑year cumulative term deposit, payable when the girl turns 21.
documents_required: KYC Norms of the Parent/ Guardian
Sanction letter from the CDPO (Child Development Project Officer)
